data.name: Durvasa
data.long_meaning: Durvasa is the name of an angry god in Hindu mythology. He is known to have cursed various gods and sages due to his quick temperament. This name symbolizes strength, power, and the unpredictability of emotions.

in_sanskrit.name: दुर्वास
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Durvasa is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dur’ meaning difficult or hard and ‘vas’ meaning to please or satisfy. The name Durvasa signifies someone who is hard to please or someone who can inflict suffering and pain.

His tales tell us about the importance of maintaining emotional balance and serve as cautionary stories for devotees."
